text:
maria: Uploading the GlyphCloud case study + co-brand pack for review. Need: partner logo files (full-color + reversed), trademark attribution line, and two approved quote variants by EOD. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/GlyphCloud-CaseStudy

maria: Also dropped asset archive (SVG/PNG/EPS) to S3: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood/partners/glyphcloud-assets-v3.zip

partner-bot: Asset import complete \u2705 — manifest: glyph-assets-v3.json. Link integrity checked.

eli: Quick design skim: hero lockup looks left-heavy. Requesting full-color SVG + light-on-dark reversed SVG and explicit clearspace spec from GlyphCloud. Leaving comments in Figma. :pencil2:

sam-legal: Legal checklist before publish: 1) explicit written approval for the quote (name + title + "OK to publish" wording preferred) 2) logo usage permission/brand kit 3) confirmation that quote contains no customer PII. Do we have an MSA clause covering marketing?

tara: Marketing asks: two quote lengths — short (~100 chars, tweet-ready) and long (~300 chars) for the web case study. Also need final image dimensions: 1200x628 hero and 280x280 social tile.

maria: GlyphCloud sent a suggested quote in email: \"Redwood's inference made deployment painless for our search stack — 4x latency improvement for live queries.\"

maria: @sam-legal can we publish that if they confirm?

sam-legal: We need sender full name + title and an explicit affirmation in writing. If they reply to the marketing thread with "OK to publish" that's sufficient. Also ensure they hold rights to the quote.

eli: If we get the OK, I'll produce alt text for the hero and export reversed SVGs. Design needs partner hex codes and preferred spacing from their brand kit.

maria: Followed up with GlyphCloud asking for: 1) approval text 2) brand hex + logo kit 3) trademark attribution line. Cc'd their marketing lead. Waiting on reply.

partner-bot: Reminder scheduled — follow-up in 48h; partner approval cutoff set to 1714303600 (unix). Will auto-ping user if no response.

tara: Contingency: if approval isn't received by EOD Friday we should publish the solution brief with a placeholder badge (no partner logo) and inform sales ops. Prefer to avoid but need runway.

eli: Tiny docs-engineering snippet for lockup layout (will push to docs repo once assets locked):

```
.partner-lockup { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:16px; }
.partner-lockup img { max-height:48px; }
@media (max-width:600px){ .partner-lockup img { max-height:36px; } }
```

eli: Also added spacing notes and a reversed SVG export in Figma (v3) — check comments.

maria: Confirmed: we will not include any partner customer logos inside the case study without separate opt-in from that customer. @sam-legal to confirm.

sam-legal: Confirmed. No customer logos without explicit consent. If GlyphCloud requires a trademark attribution line, include it verbatim per their brand guidelines.

tara: Once the quote is locked I'll draft two social posts + an email snippet. ETA: ~2 hours after final approval.

maria: Will paste GlyphCloud's approval text here if/when they reply in-thread. Thanks all.

partner-bot: Reminder queued: will post follow-up in 48h if no partner response. Reaction: :alarm_clock:
